JournalEntry.title: JournalEntry
JournalEntry.description: A user-authored daily journal reflection with optional social telemetry and shared social post metadata.

pinned.description: Whether the entry is pinned to the top of the journal.

sharedUrl.description: Optional URL captured from Android Share Sheet.

sharedPlatform.description: Optional source social platform label (e.g., Instagram, YouTube).

sharedSummary.description: Optional shared caption or post preview text.

socialSnapshotSummary.description: Optional formatted summary of social usage attached to this entry.

totalSocialMinutes.description: Total social screen-time minutes logged on the entry date (0..1440).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on creation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp updated via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on mutation.

SocialSnapshot.title: SocialSnapshot
SocialSnapshot.description: A synced social telemetry snapshot from Android UsageStatsManager or YouTube Data API v3.

sourceType.description: Origin of the real social telemetry record.

label.description: Date key or YouTube channel/video title (1..140 characters).

totalMinutes.description: Total social usage minutes for the snapshot period.

subscriberCount.description: Live YouTube channel subscriber count (0 for non-YouTube snapshots).

viewCount.description: Live YouTube channel or video view count.

platformMinutes.description: Map of social platform name to minutes used.

UserEntitlement.title: UserEntitlement
UserEntitlement.description: User's Google Play Billing ad-free premium entitlement synced to their account.

adFree.description: Whether the user holds an active ad-free entitlement.

/users/{userId}/socialSnapshots/{snapsho.description: User-scoped daily UsageStats and YouTube API snapshots.

/users/{userId}/entitlement/{docId}.description: User-scoped Play Billing ad-free entitlement record.
